persona.name: Nadia Aziz

personality.description: This person is moderately open to change, so they will try new ideas when they seem useful, but they still prefer familiar routines and a sense of stability. They tend to be spontaneous and flexible in daily habits, yet also somewhat disorganized, easily distracted, and likely to leave tasks unfinished or miss deadlines. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually evaluate what protects their own interests first, while feeling uneasy and ruminative afterward if the choice seems risky or unfair. In group discussions, they speak in a measured but guarded way, can switch between listening and contributing comfortably, and often challenge others' assumptions or motives while sounding tense under pressure.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.

relationships.name: family
relationships.description: Has children; family commitments sit outside work and occasionally cut into it.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
